verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides a documented quickstart (docs-18) with Airwallex.js and hosted payment page, a sandbox, and multiple integration options (Hosted Payment Page, Drop-in Element, Payment Links), suggesting a fast path to a working test payment. However, there's no direct evidence of copy-paste code samples across multiple languages/SDKs, nor independent confirmation that a developer can go from zero to working integration in under a day. missing for 10: multi-language copy-paste code snippets, independent/hands-on time-to-integrate confirmation, explicit SDK library coverage across languages.
